scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run check:classscribe-source-integrity && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:grade-guidance: pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe run test:grade-guidance && pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe-mobile run test:grade-guidance
scripts.test:help-navigation: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:help-navigation && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:help-support
scripts.test:syllabus-links: sh -c 'fixture=$(mktemp); trap "rm -f \"$fixture\"" EXIT; export SYLLABUS_UI_FIXTURE="$fixture"; pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:coursework && pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe run test:syllabus-tab && pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe exec node --test test/syllabus-links.test.mjs'
scripts.test:study-guides: sh -c 'fixture=$(mktemp); trap "rm -f \"$fixture\"" EXIT; export GUIDE_TEST_FIXTURE="$fixture"; pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:study-guides && pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe run test:study-guide && pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe-mobile run test:study-guide'
scripts.test:ask-switch: pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe run test:ask-switch && pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe-mobile run test:ask-switch
scripts.test:companion: pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe run test:companion && pnpm --filter @workspace/classscribe-mobile run test:companion
